title: 칠 분
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a baritone male vocal. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A string ensemble provides legato pads and counter-melodies. The tempo is 68 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal performance transitions from a breathy, intimate chest voice in the lower register to a powerful, resonant delivery in the higher register during the climax. Subtle reverb is applied to the vocals and piano to create a sense of space. The harmonic progression uses jazz-influenced extensions and secondary dominants common in contemporary Korean ballads.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[grand piano playing sustained chords]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
야간등이 번져 주황빛으로
아이가 이불을 올려 왼팔에 나를 끼고
숨소리가 고르게 바뀌어가 7분을 세는 거야
매일 밤 같은 숫자 나는 세지

[Chorus]
[strings enter, legato pads]
감울 수 없는 눈이니까
보는 것밖에 할 수 없잖아
밤이 지나도 여기 [vocal swells, piano melodic fill]
